subject: Miami Events — October 14 – October 31, 2026
intro: Hey Miami! Your October 14–31 edition brings together practical AI meetups, the eMerge AI Hackathon and Miami AI Summit, HEAT basketball, Miami Beach culture and public meetings, senior wellness and Halloween plans. Explore Miami, Miami Beach and Coral Gables; neighborhood and student-only restrictions are labeled. Books & Books is our business spotlight, and Catalyst Miami is our community spotlight. Our AI Ethics reading list asks how local builders can support accountable flood and public-service decisions, fair housing searches, hospitality workers and English, Spanish and Haitian Creole inclusion. All event times are Miami local time (EDT). Check organizer links for registration, tickets and last-minute changes; no attendance or transportation is guaranteed.
